propositions: A one-time irreversible force-push to the authoritative tickets branch must be executed with operator-confirmed zero active sessions, all rebar-mcp servers stopped, and all writers quiesced to reclaim 92% of repository size.

Pre-publication correctness assertions must verify tree identity, commit/merge counts, identical verification reports (ignoring rewritten SHAs), non-resurrection of old tip, and exclusion of old objects from default clones before the force-with-lease push.

The epoch-mismatch refusal probe using the explicitly refreshed host binary and deployed review-bot runtime must prove both refuse the old epoch before publication, replacing the former 24-hour elapsed-time proxy.

Post-window deterministic first write (the rebar.toml identity.enforce_since re-pin's LLM-Review vote) must be recorded with change/patchset/timestamp, old-tip ancestry asserted false, and size-pack growth measured below 1 MB to validate non-resurrection.
